mainText: Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! At 9 PM, the skies over Fireman's Park are crystal clear. We have a first quarter moon tonight, and you can catch the space station flying over from Cross Plains toward Oregon around 11:10 PM, reaching about halfway up the sky. We are cooling down to 53 degrees tonight, and there is absolutely no rain in the forecast.
Did you know you can catch city government meetings and community shows on VHAT? Check out their schedule on channel 989 or jump on their YouTube channel to stay in the loop.

Get ready for a fun night out! Trivia is happening today at Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's. Plus, keep the good times rolling tomorrow with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park.
On July 13th, police had to assist a driver who managed to get their vehicle stuck on a giant rock, resulting in an O-W-I arrest.
Treat yourself to the Chocolate Caramel Twist! They are open for less than an hour, so hurry over to get your fix before they lock the doors.
